risks.title: Raw material and energy price volatility
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned first in risk factors and concerns key raw materials (recovered paper, virgin fiber) as well as energy. Language intensity is moderate, but potential impact on production costs is significant, as shown by post-combination energy cost increases.

risks.title: Interest rate risk on variable debt
risks.score_rationale: This risk is discussed first in the financial risks section. While majority of interest costs are hedged, a 1% increase in interest rates on variable debt would result in approximately $17 million decline in earnings before taxes.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk on international operations
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed and concerns a significant portion of sales (54% in 2025). A 1% appreciation of the US dollar would reduce shareholders' equity by approximately $114 million, indicating substantial financial impact.

risks.title: Goodwill impairment and valuation risk
risks.score_rationale: Goodwill represents a significant portion of the balance sheet ($7.2 billion USD). The audit specifically mentions assessment of qualitative indicators of goodwill impairment as a critical audit matter requiring complex subjective judgments, involving financial projections and raw material/energy costs.

risks.title: Risk related to business combination (Smurfit Westrock)
risks.score_rationale: The combination with WestRock resulted in significant energy cost increases in 2024 and 2025. While specific details of integration are not fully described as a risk, the impact on costs is clearly identified as a negative factor.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
